author: Steve Wallis
description: I had a lovely little evening of camping on a relatively warm day and decided to try and cool off the tent with a bunch of coolers with 140 pounds of ice. I attached all the coolers together with dryer venting and attached a small usb fan. I was able to get some good cooling from the ice with some modifications. It was a great camping meal, great camping company, and overall a fun camping trip.
title: Ice Cooled Tent Camping
